John — great questions, answered inline below. I’ve also attached the SOC2 pdf and the questionnaire we discussed (filled partially). Neha will lead the technical call and provide detailed architecture and controls.

- SOC 2: attached is the Type II report and the auditor contact is: BrightGate Audit LLP, audit@brightgate.com. We can coordinate a validation call if your team wants to follow up.

- EU-only residency: 
  - Hosted API: we operate AWS/GC/OCI regions in eu-west-1, eu-central-1, etc. For hosted customers, we offer region-pin routing which keeps inference workloads and primary logs in the selected region. However, standard hosted telemetry (aggregated metrics/ops alerts) may be routed to a centralized control plane which can be US-based depending on the customer configuration — that is configurable and can be restricted for enterprise accounts.
  - Dedicated & Private: Dedicated reserved pools in EU will keep all inference, KV cache, and backups in-region. Private (VPC or on-prem) provides full control — no cross-border transfers unless you enable an integration. For customers requiring strict EU-only processing (e.g., certain healthcare use cases), we recommend Private or Dedicated with region-locking.

- KMS / key management: we support customer-managed keys for Dedicated and Private. For hosted, we offer both Redwood-managed KMS and customer-managed keys via KMS integrations — key material is not accessible to Redwood when customer-managed keys are used. Neha can show the KMS flow on the call.

- OFAC/ITAR / export control policy: Redwood has documented procedures for handling legal requests. For ITAR-restricted workloads we recommend Private (on-prem) deployments. OFAC screening is supported at the application layer; we do not proactively route customer content to sanctioned jurisdictions. We’ll share our export-control policy doc on the call.

- DPA: yes — Redwood routinely signs customer DPAs. Rishi will coordinate commercial and DPA redlines with your Legal team.

Proposed technical call: Tue 24 Nov 11:00–12:00 CET — is that still good? I’ll also have Neha prepare a short slide pack showing: data flow, KMS patterns, backups/retention, and logging/trace retention.
